# Claim Intel — Deploy (static)

This folder is a static site. No build step required.

## Fastest shareable link (Netlify Drop)

1. Open https://app.netlify.com/drop
2. Drag the **`site`** folder from this `dist` directory onto the page
   (or unzip `claim-intel.zip` and drag the extracted `site` folder)
3. Netlify gives you a public URL like `https://random-name-123.netlify.app`

Sign up / log in if prompted so the site stays up.

## Single-file option

`index.html` in this `dist` folder is a fully inlined one-file build.
You can also drag **only that file** onto Netlify Drop.
